title: Station Rotation: CHEM 3A Lab Practical — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice for the CHEM 3A lab practical. Mock Practical: 10 timed stations (4 minutes + 1 minute to rotate, then a 5-minute wrap-up), each showing Versions A, B and C; the student picks or draws a green, yellow or purple answer sheet and the screen turns that color. Answers are free response and graded like the real practical (value, sig figs and units). Practice by Lab: untimed questions with hints, worked answers and videos for every experiment: Lab Exploration, Making Measurements, Atomic Mass (Fresnocitium beads: percent abundance, weighted average), Found or Forgery (flame tests, average atomic mass of lead), Rolling for Compound Initiative (naming), Empirical Formula, Molecular Modeling, Calorimetry (Part 1, plus the Part 2 ice and ΔHfus check), Gas Constant R, Electrons in Atoms (Rydberg equation), Law of Constant Composition (Cu/S mass ratio), Solutions and Dilutions, Types of Reactions (Scheme 2), Synthesis of Alum, pH of Household Items, Citric Acid in Soda (titration). Matched to the Fall 2026 CHEM 3A Lab Manual and its Lab Practical Study Guide. Drawn graduated cylinders, burets, gas collection tubes, thermometers, rulers, balances, test tube reactions, flame tests, cabbage indicator colors and ball-and-stick models. PhET Lab Bench: embedded PhET simulations with checked tasks. Add ?labs=dan to show only Dr. Dan's current lab list. Other instructors can use setup.html to get a Canvas link (?prof=, ?labs=, ?sec=) that opens with their own labs; listed professors' labs come from their public Simple Syllabus syllabi (classes.js).
